name: artist
label: One artist (from a photo)
about: The same person sings every line: each shot puts the artist from one reference photo in a new outfit, setting and light (Qwen-Image identity edit); the flash twins are the same artist in a different look, like quick costume changes.

close.lens: on a wide-angle lens very close to the face
close.sing: Handheld close-up of {who} singing straight into the camera. The lips form each word clearly with wide open mouth movements, expressive lips and jaw moving with the lyrics, natural breathing, small head bobs and eyebrow raises on the beat. {move} Both hands stay below the frame. No one else in frame.

medium.shot: Medium shot from the waist up, taken from about two metres away
medium.lens: on a 35mm lens, with clear space above the head, the face small in the frame (about a quarter of its height)
medium.sing: Medium shot of {who} {action}, singing toward the camera. The lips form each word clearly with open mouth movements, shoulders and head move with the rhythm, natural breathing. {move} No one else in frame.

wide.shot: Wide full-body shot, the whole person from head to feet in frame with space above the head
wide.lens: on a 24mm lens a few meters away
wide.sing: Wide shot of {who} {action}, singing along, the lips forming the words, moving freely with the rhythm. {move} No one else in frame.

Keep the exact same person with the same face and identity, and the same camera angle, framing, head position, mouth shape and expression.
